note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1967. The Richhill contest and the unopposed return in Killyman are filed. The Belfast Telegraph (17 May 1967, p. 4) reports that Francis J. McOscar, the sitting member for Charlemont, was opposed by a former councillor, Patrick Fox, but no Charlemont result was found (the results printed on 2 June name only Richhill, and McOscar sat on the council afterwards), so Charlemont is not filed. The members returned unopposed in the other divisions are not named in the reports read. Polled 1 June 1967. "Richhill Unionists have lost the village seat on Armagh Rural Council to Independent Mr. John B. Lamb"; the report does not print a label for Kelly. "The election was the first in Richhill for almost a century."
